## Monthly Streaming Watch Time Overview

A small six-month series like this is best shown with a chart that makes the trend easy to scan and a second chart that highlights month-to-month change.

## Recommended Chart Types

| Chart Type | What it Shows | Best Use |
|---|---|---|
| Line chart | The overall trend across Jan–Jun, with rises and dips between months | Best for seeing the pattern over time |
| Column chart | Each month as a separate bar, making monthly comparisons very clear | Best for comparing exact month values |

### Why these two work well
- **Line chart:** shows the household’s viewing pattern as a timeline, so the jump from **Mar to Apr** and the later peak in **May** stand out quickly.
- **Column chart:** makes it easy to compare exact monthly totals, especially the gap between the low point in **Mar** and the high point in **May**.

## Main Pattern in the Data

- Watch time starts at **12 hours in Jan**, rises to **15 in Feb**, then drops to **10 in Mar**.
- It then climbs sharply to **18 in Apr** and peaks at **22 in May** before easing to **16 in Jun**.
- Overall, the series shows a **mid-period dip followed by a strong rebound**, with the highest usage in late spring.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: View line chart] https://www.datawrapper.de/charts/line-chart
Action: [Button: View bar chart] https://www.datawrapper.de/charts/bar-chart

## Sources

- Chart selection guidance: https://www.datawrapper.de/blog/line-chart-or-bar-chart/
